name: Gold-marked Thread-waisted Wasp
desc: Gold-marked Thread-waisted Wasp (Eremnophila aureonotata): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Eremnophila aureonotata, also known as the gold-marked thread-waisted wasp, is a species in the family Sphecidae ("thread-waisted wasps") found in North and South America.
